name: missing_quotes_attribute_injection
description: Security-relevant near-miss: fixes the headline bug the snapshot's BUG comment leads with (adds ampersand-first escaping of &, <, >) but stops short of adding quote escaping. Text-context XSS via <, > and & is prevented, but a value placed inside a quoted HTML attribute can still break out via an unescaped " or ' and inject new attributes/handlers -- a naive fix that addresses only the most visible symptom.
